MENU_DESC: A cozy camp, a giant fire and a very questionable hunting trip. Host a game for up to three friends.
CONTROLS: WASD move · SHIFT sprint · SPACE jump · RMB aim · LMB fire · R reload · E interact · B bag · ESC menu · T rally point
WEAPONS_DESC: Pick a weapon. Inspect it, buy it, then make it ridiculous.
BAGS_DESC: More space, longer hunts. Browse your next backpack.
SELL_DESC: Your loot, your money. Sell the contents of your backpack.
INVENTORY_DESC: Visit the loot exchange to sell your catch.
EMPTY_BAG:
Empty backpack.

Collect loot and bring it back to camp.
FULL_BAG: Backpack full! Sell your loot or buy a bigger bag.
BAG_OWNED: You already have a bag this size or bigger.
NOTHING_TO_SELL: Your bag is empty. Bring loot from a hunt.
rusty_pistol_desc: Fast shots, low damage. 6 damage / 0.65 s.
double_barrel_desc: Six pellets; best at close range. 18 total damage / 1.8 s.
expedition: Choose a map at the campfire
DEER_DOWN: Deer down! Press E near the pelt to collect it.
TRAINING_DESC:
Deer nearby · aim + fire
Collect pelt with E · sell at camp
NET_FAILED: Connection failed. Check IP and UDP port.
NET_LOST: Host disconnected. Back in a solo camp.
NET_FULL: This camp already has four hunters.
NET_NOTE: Direct IP · host + 3 friends · Steam integration later
DRIVING: WASD drive · SPACE brake · E exit when stopped · V recover if overturned · ESC menu
STOP_TO_EXIT: Stop the jeep before getting out.
TRUNK_DESC: Shared storage. Each item keeps its owner.
TRUNK_FULL: Trunk full. Your remaining loot stays in your backpack.
PARK_TO_SELL: Park the jeep near this stall to sell trunk loot.
NETWORK_NOTE: Direct IP · host + 3 friends · Steam integration later
ROTATE_HINT: DRAG TO ROTATE  ·  SCROLL TO ZOOM
BAG_CAROUSEL_DESC: Carry up to {n} loot slots. Every animal you bring home funds the next upgrade.
WEAPON_LOCKED: Buy this weapon before equipping it.
scrap_blaster_desc: A drum-fed scrap shotgun. Eight pellets, one very bad day for the target.
beehive_desc: Hold the trigger. Six barrels and a swarm of angry bullets.
thunder_tube_desc: An absurd coil cannon. Big light, big noise, bigger damage.
WAIT_HOST: Waiting for the host to start
LOBBY_HOST_HINT: E near the campfire → Choose a map and start the expedition
LOBBY_DESC: Prepare in camp. The host starts a separate forest world after everyone loads.
LOADING_WAIT: Map ready. Waiting for the team…
LOADING_TIP: Your weapons, backpack and owned loot travel with you. The jeep spawns beside the group.
LOADING_FAILED: Map loading failed. Returning to camp.
WAIT_CONNECTIONS: Wait for the hunters who are still connecting.
JEEP_RECOVERY_DENIED: Recover an overturned jeep when it is stopped and you are nearby.
MAP_SUBTITLE: One campfire. One crew. The next hunt.
MAP_FOREST_DESC: A vast forest, clearings and increasingly powerful prey. Your jeep arrives beside the crew.
MAP_ANIMALS:
Rabbit · Deer · Boar · Wolf · Bear
1–4 hunters · 1.2 × 1.2 km
MAP_HOST_HINT: You are the host. The crew departs after everyone has loaded the map.
MAP_CLIENT_HINT: The host chooses and starts the expedition for the whole crew.
MAP_AT_FIRE: Approach the campfire to start the expedition.
DOWNED_HELP: You are downed. A teammate must hold E beside you for 3 seconds.
MAP_SWAMP_DESC: A misty wetland with shallow pools, reeds and abandoned timber paths. Stay together: the water hides hungry predators.
MAP_SWAMP_ANIMALS:
Frog → Turtle → Snake → Crocodile → Ancient crocodile
Better loot · Tougher wildlife · Mud reduces speed and tire grip
